generationRecords.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Precisely relight this ONE existing sleeping illustration with a very soft WARM NIGHTLIGHT. Preserve its complete composition, linework, scene geometry, character and sleeping pose. Do not redraw or add props.
Keep the deep indigo exterior, muted night clouds and cool ambient shadows. Set the EXISTING partially cropped desk lamp at the far LEFT to a very dim warm nightlight setting, far softer than a working/reading lamp. Its shade's underside glows softly pale amber with controlled luminance, NOT white-hot yellow. The lamp projects a small low-intensity warm pool down and right onto the nearby book spines, mug, closed laptop edge and wooden tabletop. This light softly falls off as it travels toward Taozi. A delicate warm reflected fill gently touches the left-facing peach hair tips, her near cheek and the tops of the cream sleeves supporting her face. Most of her hair, far shoulder, chair and room remain in cool blue-violet shadow. The viewer should feel late-night quiet warmth within a cool dark room, not a fully illuminated workspace.
Use physically coherent occlusion and falloff: the lamp is on the left, so warm planes face left and cast shadows fall right; hair casts soft-edged simple shadow onto face/arms; no warm glow on the far curtain/window or luminous halo around the entire head. Her sleeping face remains subdued, only gently readable; retain closed eyelids, quiet expression and exact features. The brightest area is the small lamp underside and nearby desk, not her face. Maintain restrained pastel anime colored fine lines and simple lavender cel shading; smooth lighting modulation is fine but do not add airbrushed texture, fog, bloom, heavy rim lights, grain or shiny skin.
STRICT invariants: keep same head/neck/arms, peach bob and navy bookmark ribbon, clothing and collar, every object and position, square crop, window and cloud layout. Laptop remains fully CLOSED with no lit screen. Small notebook by the mug remains fully CLOSED. No added nightlight object, no new text, no candles, no symbols, no stars, no blush. Only change illumination from dim blue-only night to dim blue night with a gentle local amber nightlight.
